verdicts.reason: A is basically the original scaled down. The window, headline and details keep their places, but the date/address text gets tiny and faint at this height, and large dead bands are left above and below. B makes the text bigger and wraps the details into a tidy right-aligned three-line block that is much easier to read. However, 'Sunday' nearly touches the stained-glass window and the window almost runs into the top and bottom edges of the canvas, so it feels cramped. B is still the stronger, more readable banner.
